tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Run git history analysis on a codebase. Returns commit convention patterns, stale directories, and frequently changed files. These are aggregate stats across hundreds of commits that would be expensive to compute manually.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: export_to_confluence
tools.description: Sync the project's concept map to Confluence as product-readable wiki pages: an index page, one page per feature (PM-language descriptions, no file paths), and a changelog page. Mason replaces managed page bodies; manual edits to those bodies are overwritten. Requires `mason_set_confluence` to have been called first.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

parentPageId.description: Override the configured parent page ID

indexPageTitle.description: Title of the index page (default: 'Mason — System Map')

changelogPageTitle.description: Title of the changelog page (default: 'Mason — Changelog')

featurePagePrefix.description: Prefix for each feature page title (default: 'Feature: ')

tools.name: full_analysis
tools.description: One-shot orientation for a project WITHOUT a concept map (get_snapshot returned exists:false). Returns git history stats, project structure with file counts, curated code sample previews (~60 lines each), and test-to-source mapping. On a mapped project, prefer get_snapshot — it is cheaper and answers feature/architecture questions directly.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: generate_snapshot_batch
tools.description: Map step of the concept-map build. Returns one batch of source files (skeletons of every file in the batch plus a few deeper-read bodies for grounding), along with a system prompt instructing you to derive features and flows for ONLY this batch. Call repeatedly with the returned `nextOffset` until it is null, calling `save_partial_snapshot` between each call. Use product-natural feature names so partials merge cleanly in the reduce step.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

offset.description: 0-indexed file offset to start the batch at. Omit on the first call; pass the `nextOffset` from the previous response for subsequent calls.

files.description: Scope the batch walk to this explicit file list — e.g. the drift set from mason_check_drift (changedFiles + unmappedFiles). Pass the SAME list on every batch call of one refresh run. Triggers refresh mode: reduce_snapshot will merge the partials into the existing map instead of rebuilding it.

tools.name: get_code_samples
tools.description: Get previews (first ~60 lines) of representative source files from the codebase. Includes entry points, config files, hot files (frequently changed), test examples, and one file per directory for breadth. Read files natively for full content.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

count.description: Maximum number of files to sample (default: 15)

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Assemble task context: matching decisions with rationale, approval, owner, sources, last review, and freshness, plus related tests, file impact, and any available map entries. Map verification is rechecked against sampled source contents; stale or unknown verification requires a fresh review, and recordedVerdict preserves the historical verdict. Proposals are suggestions; legacy records are unreviewed; accepted decisions are constraints subject to freshness. No initialization or map required. Pass task and optional files. map.status and diagnostics preserve missing or invalid knowledge. Impact covers up to three unique files, expanding directory anchors.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

task.description: The task, bug, or change request in natural language — e.g. 'add rate limiting to the API client' or a ticket description

files.description: Optional file paths already known to be involved (e.g. from a diff or stack trace). Entries containing them are boosted above pure text matches.

tools.name: get_impact
tools.description: Trace historical co-change partners, related tests, and references with evidence: resolved imports, explicit paths, or uncertain name candidates. Candidates are not proven dependencies. Deterministic and read-only; no initialization or concept map required.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

files.description: File paths or names to analyze (e.g., ['WeatherRepository.kt'] or ['src/services/auth.ts'])

tools.name: get_snapshot
tools.description: Return the optional feature-to-file architecture map with drift and trust evidence. Map verification is rechecked against sampled source contents; stale or unknown verification requires a fresh review, and recordedVerdict preserves the historical verdict. If no map exists, returns exists:false plus project structure, Git signals, and test pairs. Decision capture, get_context, and get_impact still work. No initialization required.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: mason_automation
tools.description: Inspect installed automation and observed host events, or resume/check retained documentation repair evidence across sessions. status is read-only; check saves local baselines and verification reports without editing source or approving advisories. Returns concise results with a full report path. Works without a map.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project directory

action.description: Inspect configuration and receipts, or capture/resume and verify original audit evidence.

tools.name: mason_check_drift
tools.description: Check how far the concept map has drifted from HEAD. Deterministic (git + filesystem, no LLM). Returns which features/flows are stale and the changed files behind them, new source files not yet mapped, ghost files (mapped but deleted), renames, and a `recommendation`: `up-to-date` (nothing to do), `incremental` (update just the stale entries via save_snapshot), or `full-rebuild` (re-run the Map-Reduce build). Call this before trusting the map in a long session, or periodically to keep the map and any synced wikis fresh.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: mason_complete_init
tools.description: Record assistant instruction setup locally in ignored .mason/local/project.json, with feature settings in shared .mason/config.json. Other tools work without this marker. Repeated calls preserve the original setup time and existing settings; pass confluenceConfigured only to change that setting.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

confluenceConfigured.description: Set the Confluence setup status; omit to preserve the existing value

tools.name: mason_init
tools.description: Inspect this project now: returns documentation audit findings, committed-diff review findings, decision/map status, and a quickstart playbook. Quickstart and map modes are read-only and deterministic. Explicit mode: setup configures MCP, instructions and lifecycle hooks to use mason on PATH while retaining original audit evidence; use it only when the user requests setup. Optional host selects codex or claude. Optional base selects the review comparison; evidence imports CI manifests with check outcomes, commit freshness, and links to changed files and accepted decisions. mode: map returns the full Map-Reduce build workflow. Repeat calls refresh findings even after setup.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

mode.description: Quickstart inspects without edits; map requests an architecture build; setup installs the shared onboarding flow.

host.description: Assistant to configure in setup mode; inferred only when unambiguous.

base.description: Git ref for committed-diff review. Defaults to the first available main branch ref.

evidence.description: Repository-local CI evidence manifests to include in the review. Imports Vitest JSON, SARIF, and native-validator mason-check-json results without executing check commands.

tools.name: mason_repair
tools.description: Track documentation repairs against original audit evidence. prepare saves a local baseline and returns a scoped work order; verify reads that baseline and reports resolved, unresolved, review-required, unverified, and new findings. Suppressed advisories remain unresolved. Does not edit documentation or approve decisions. No map required.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

baselinePath.description: Original baseline path returned by prepare; required for verify.

checks.description: Optional audit check subset for prepare. Verification always uses the original checks.

tools.name: mason_set_confluence
tools.description: Configure Confluence credentials. Two-step flow: (1) call without `spaceKey` to validate the credentials and receive a list of available spaces — relay them to the user. (2) call again with the same `baseUrl`/`email`/`apiToken` plus the chosen `spaceKey` to persist. Credentials are stored in `~/.mason/config.json`. Warn the user that the API token will be visible in chat history before they paste it.

baseUrl.description: Confluence base URL. Accepts `acme`, `acme.atlassian.net`, or `https://acme.atlassian.net` (normalized automatically).

spaceKey.description: Confluence space key. Omit on the first call to list available spaces.

parentPageId.description: Optional parent page ID under which Mason's index page is created

tools.name: reduce_snapshot
tools.description: Reduce step of the concept-map build. Returns every partial snapshot plus a system prompt asking you to merge them into one coherent project-wide map. Resolve platform variants into single product features, dedupe near-duplicates, and ensure no file is dropped. After producing the unified map, call `save_snapshot` to persist it (this also clears the partials).

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

tools.name: review_advisory
tools.description: Prepare an assessment of an original repair advisory and its exact repository scope, then record authorized addressed, inapplicable or deferred outcomes with reviewToken, reviewer and note. Relevant changes reopen reviews; unrelated commits preserve them. Records belong in Git. Decision findings route to review_decision; this tool never approves decisions. Recorded identities are assertions, not authenticated approvals.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root

tools.name: review_decision
tools.description: Prepare a decision review: returns the full record and history, any operative accepted revision, provenance, changes and previews for both sets of anchors, and a reviewToken. Then record accept, reaffirm, or retire with that token, the authorized reviewer, and a reason. Acceptance replaces the operative revision; retirement withdraws the entire record including its proposal. Acceptance requires owner, source, readable Git HEAD, and committed anchor changes. Changed records or code invalidate the token. Identities and approvals are recorded assertions for normal PR review, not authenticated proof.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

id.description: Decision id from get_context or save_decision

action.description: Prepare is read-only. Other actions record an explicitly authorized review.

reviewer.description: Identity of the actual reviewer; required for a verdict. Never invent one.

note.description: Review rationale; required for a verdict. Cite evidence for the decision.

reviewToken.description: Token from the prepared review; rejects stale record or code revisions

tools.name: save_decision
tools.description: Capture or revise a decision proposal with rationale, anchors, optional owner, sources, and a known actor. Compare matching get_context records and pending proposals before saving. When new evidence changes the same lesson's assumptions, scope, or recommended action, pass its existing id, including for accepted records. Preserve supported rationale and sources and replace obsolete instructions. Create a new record for a genuinely distinct lesson; skip unchanged restatements. No setup or map required. Writes a local record and preserves content history. Changes create a pending proposal while the last accepted revision remains operative; unchanged content does not re-verify or refresh it. Use review_decision for authorized acceptance or reaffirmation. A proposal cannot supersede a record with an operative accepted revision; review its replacement and retire the original separately.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

title.description: Short, specific headline (max 80 characters). Generates a stable id on creation; revising the title keeps the existing id.

body.description: The knowledge itself: what was tried/decided, why, and what to avoid. Must contain information NOT derivable by reading the code. Aim for 1500 characters or fewer; up to 2500 is accepted with a warning above the target. Matching context and hooks include the full body. Preserve exceptions; use sources for supporting references.

files.description: Repo-relative files or directory prefixes this applies to. Matching is shared by retrieval, hooks, review, and drift checking; changes flag the decision for re-verification.

id.description: Pass the matching record's existing id when evidence changes that lesson's assumptions, scope, or recommended action, including for accepted records. Changed content becomes a proposal while the accepted version remains operative; unchanged content leaves review and freshness untouched.

supersedes.description: Id of an unreviewed record or proposal with no accepted revision to replace. Operative accepted decisions require separate review and retirement.

owner.description: Responsible person or team, when known. Null clears it. Required for acceptance.

sources.description: Known PR, issue, incident, discussion, or document references. Omit to preserve; [] clears. At least one is required for acceptance.

actor.description: Known person or agent recording this revision. Omit if unknown; do not infer from Git identity.

force.description: Save even when a near-duplicate was detected

tools.name: save_partial_snapshot
tools.description: Persist the partial concept map you derived for one batch. Call this once per batch, with the `batchId` from the `generate_snapshot_batch` response. Partials accumulate in `.mason/partial-snapshots/` and are merged in the reduce step.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

offset.description: The `offset` returned by `generate_snapshot_batch`. Used to order partials in the reduce step.

type.description: "capability" (user-facing functionality) or "infrastructure" (internal plumbing with no end user — DI/service wiring, config, logging, adapters). Defaults to "capability".

features.description: Partial features for this batch only — files outside the batch will be added by other partials.

flows.description: Partial flows whose entire chain is in this batch. Cross-batch flows are reconstructed in reduce.

tools.name: save_snapshot
tools.description: Save a concept-to-files map as a persistent project snapshot. Maps feature names and data flows to the files that implement them. Persists across conversations — future sessions can call get_snapshot to instantly find relevant files. No API key needed — you are the LLM generating the map.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

files.description: File paths that implement this feature

tests.description: Test file paths for this feature

type.description: Classification: "capability" for user-facing functionality, "infrastructure" for internal plumbing with no end user (DI/service wiring, config, logging, adapters). Capabilities are published to Confluence; infrastructure stays in the AI concept map only. Defaults to "capability".

features.description: Map of feature names to their implementing files

chain.description: Ordered list of file paths showing data/call flow

flows.description: Map of flow names to ordered file chains

removeFeatures.description: Feature names to delete from the existing map — for features that were renamed or no longer exist. Applied before merging; only meaningful on incremental saves.

removeFlows.description: Flow names to delete from the existing map. Applied before merging; only meaningful on incremental saves.

tools.name: save_verification
tools.description: Record verify_snapshot verdicts using each entry’s kind and reviewToken. Missing tokens request a fresh review; changed or deleted entries return conflicts without being stamped. Entries judged ok are stamped verifiedAt; failures are flagged verificationFailed with your note and surface in get_context, get_snapshot, and mason_check_drift until corrected. Verdict notes are required for failures.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory

kind.description: Entry kind returned by verify_snapshot; required to record a verdict

reviewToken.description: Copy the reviewToken from verify_snapshot after inspecting its evidence; required to record a verdict

note.description: One line on what's wrong — required when ok is false

verdicts.description: Entry name → verdict, exactly as returned by verify_snapshot

tools.name: verify_snapshot
tools.description: Spot-check the concept map's CORRECTNESS (drift checks freshness; this checks entries were right to begin with). Returns a sample of entries — always the never-verified and least-recently-verified first — with skeletons of their claimed files, for you to judge whether the files actually implement what the entry claims. Report verdicts back via save_verification with each entry’s kind and reviewToken. Tokens bind the entry and bounded source evidence; changed evidence requires a fresh review. Run periodically, or after an automated refresh wrote entries no human reviewed.

dir.description: Absolute path to the project root directory
